responsibility: Implements the ISO termination-status wrapper by delegating directly to M2RTS. Its responsibility is to expose the standard library predicates for overall termination-in-progress and HALT detection, without owning shutdown logic itself; the actual state is maintained by the central runtime support module.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the executable implementation of TERMINATION: unlike the same-stem .def interface, it imports M2RTS and defines IsTerminating and HasHalted by forwarding to the runtime’s termination-state routines.
